tasks.short: Keep our pay and promotion method consistent across both CAOs and three sites.

today.trigger: A CAO renewal, a site doing promotions its own way, or the HR Director asking why two similar jobs pay differently.
steps: Pull current scales, tredes and allowances from AFAS Profit and the latest policy on SharePoint.
Read both CAO texts for function groups, steps and mandatory allowances such as shift and unsocial hours.
Compare how Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo set starting pay and promotion in practice.
Write a method note in Word and a rough wage-bill effect in Excel.
Walk it through the HR Director and, where the rule changes, the works council.
drudgery: Hunting which PDF of the pay policy is the current one
Retyping scale tables from Excel into Word
Rewriting the same explanation for managers, payroll and the OR
today.time_sinks: Most of the 54 hours goes to finding the current rule and rewriting it for each audience, not to the decision itself.

lenses.faster: The method note starts from the AFAS scales and the CAO clauses, so retyping tables and rewriting the note per site drops out. The OR meeting and the decision take the same time they take now.
lenses.autonomous: A published CAO change or a scale edit in AFAS opens a review file with the delta and the people who must be consulted. The specialist still decides whether the method should change.
lenses.ambitious: At a tenth of the cost, Noordhaven would keep one living method for pay, promotion and job level across both CAOs and review it every quarter. Each review would also show whether the method shows up in 90-day retention and in manager satisfaction with HR.
lenses.joy: Reconciling three scale spreadsheets is work nobody will miss. What remains is the judgment about what is fair under the CAO and what a shift lead can be told in one sentence.
lenses.options: Each review produces a few workable methods on one page, with wage-bill effect and whether OR consent is required: strict CAO steps, a narrow band for scarce roles such as CE drivers, and a site allowance where the labour market differs.
lenses.altitude: The specialist maintains the rules and the exception list that generate the method, and spends the meeting on cases the rules cannot cover. The Word file stops being a personal draft that only one person can find.
reach: HR Business Partner: prepare the allowed step and the precedent before a promotion talk with a manager.
FP&A Analyst: hand over the cost of a method change as a scenario for the labour-cost forecast.
Payroll Specialist: provide a test list of AFAS wage components the method would add or retire.

tasks.human_edge: Judging what Noordhaven can defend under both CAOs, and what the HR Director and the works council will stand behind in a room.
tasks.pattern_why: The result is a method the HR Director and the OR must own. A model can draft and compare options from CAO text and AFAS tables. It cannot decide a remuneration rule, and there is no single checkable answer.

in_practice.trigger: A new CAO text arrives, someone changes a scale in AFAS, or a quarterly review date falls.
steps: Assemble the current scales, allowances, function groups and the last OR decision from AFAS and SharePoint.
Draft a short method note that stays inside both CAOs and states who is covered, own staff only.
Attach two or three options with a wage-bill sketch payroll and FP&A can check.
Specialist and HR Director choose. Where the choice changes a remuneration or job-grading rule, it goes to the OR for consent before anyone applies it.
File the approved method next to the handbook and point the old file at it.
in_practice.human_gate: Nothing is published or applied until the specialist and the HR Director agree, and the OR has consented where the change is a remuneration or job-grading regulation.
data_needed: CAO name and function group
Scale, trede and allowance components
Site, department and contract type (own staff or agency)
Prior OR decisions on pay rules
Headcount and FTE by scale for the cost sketch
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint pay-method library: decision, date, options rejected, and the CAO articles relied on.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit stores salary scales, periodic increments and wage components as structured payroll data a method note can be checked against.
Microsoft 365 Copilot drafts and rewrites a Word note from files already held in SharePoint.
Dutch works councils have a consent right on regulations for remuneration and job grading, so a method change remains a human decision.
AI used to decide promotion or pay for individual workers falls in the employment category of high-risk AI under the EU AI Act, which is why this stays a draft with a named decision-maker.

risks: An AI draft treated as the new pay policy will break trust with the OR and can be an unlawful change to a remuneration rule.
A method that conflicts with CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer or the warehouse CAO is void for the workers that CAO covers.
Pasting individual salaries into a consumer chatbot breaches the AVG. Any assistive tool has to run on company tenants with AFAS data minimised.
research_questions: Which pay and promotion rules are fixed by the two CAOs, and which are company policy that needs OR consent?
Of these 54 hours a year, how many are rewriting notes versus sitting with the OR, HRBPs and managers?
Is the functiehuis and scale table stored in AFAS, or is the source of truth an Excel file on SharePoint?
Will the OR read an AI-assisted method note if the specialist signs it and each claim cites a CAO article?

tasks.short: Check that appraisals and pay stay fair, and explain that to the OR.

today.trigger: The annual appraisal and scale round, an OR question about fair pay, or a manager challenging a trede.
steps: Collect appraisal outcomes and the scale steps payroll actually applied.
Compare pay for similar function groups across sites, CAOs and contract hours.
Draft what appraisal is allowed to change in pay under the CAO and company policy.
Discuss the picture with HRBPs and the HR Director.
Prepare the note for the OR and answer manager questions during the round.
drudgery: Matching appraisal files to the correct AFAS employee and scale
Rebuilding the same comparison workbook each year
Explaining one disputed trede from a thread of old mails
today.time_sinks: The hours disappear into matching last year's ratings to what payroll did, and into one-by-one manager replies.

lenses.faster: The comparison of scale, trede, site and appraisal score is prepared from AFAS before the round starts, so the specialist edits findings. The talks with managers and the OR stay on the calendar.
lenses.autonomous: When the appraisal window closes, a review file opens: steps applied, similar jobs with different pay, and missing ratings. It waits for the specialist. It does not send anything to the OR or to a manager.
lenses.ambitious: At a tenth of the cost, Noordhaven would check equal pay for equal work at every scale round, by function group, site and hours, and would tell the OR in the same quarter. That is the programme done on purpose, including the pay-transparency facts a 1,200-person employer has to be ready to show.
lenses.joy: Rebuilding the annual workbook is the part nobody will miss. The work people value is a straight answer on a disputed step and a fair rule the OR has already seen.
lenses.options: The briefing can show more than one remedy for a gap: correct a trede, fix a mis-graded job, or change the rule. Each option has who decides, whether the OR must consent, and the back-pay risk.
lenses.altitude: The specialist sets the tests for a fair round (same function group, same CAO, explainable gap) and reviews the failures. HRBPs still hold the conversation with the manager and the employee.
reach: HR Business Partner: a prepared pack for a disputed appraisal-to-pay case, before the manager meeting.
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: the definition of the equal-pay cut so it lives in Power BI.
HR Director: the first draft of the OR note on pay outcomes of the appraisal round.

tasks.human_edge: Carrying the conversation when a rule changes someone's income, and deciding what is an equal-pay issue versus a job graded on the wrong CAO function group.
tasks.pattern_why: The programme is administered through people: managers, HRBPs, payroll and the OR. AI can prepare the comparison and the briefing. Applying a pay consequence to a named person stays a human decision because of equal treatment, works-council rights and liability.

in_practice.trigger: Appraisal scores are in, or the OR or HR Director asks for the pay-fairness picture before the scale round.
steps: Build a checked table from AFAS: function group, CAO, scale, trede, FTE, site, allowances, and appraisal score where the company uses one.
Flag similar jobs with pay gaps the rules do not explain, and flags for groups too small to show.
Draft the programme note: what appraisal may change in pay, what it must not change, and what the comparison found.
Specialist reviews every proposed individual correction with the HRBP and payroll.
HR Director takes the aggregate note to the OR. Individual cases stay out of that paper.
in_practice.human_gate: No individual's pay changes because of this review unless the specialist, the HRBP and payroll each agree, and the reason is written down. The OR note goes out only after the HR Director signs it.
data_needed: Function group, CAO, scale, trede, allowances, FTE, site
Appraisal score and year, if appraisal is allowed to move pay
Gender and contract hours where needed for an equal-pay cut
Team size, so cells of fewer than a small threshold can be suppressed
The written company rule on periodieken versus appraisal-based pay
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint file for the annual pay and appraisal review: aggregate findings, OR date, and a separate restricted list of individual corrections with the reason.

evidence.claim: Power BI on the nightly AFAS extract can report pay by scale, site and FTE from data Noordhaven already extracts.

Directive (EU) 2023/970 sets pay-transparency and gender pay-gap reporting duties for employers of Noordhaven's size, on a phased timetable. Dutch implementing details still have to be read off the transposition text.
Microsoft 365 Copilot can draft the OR briefing from the approved table and the prior year's note on SharePoint.

risks: A gender or site gap shown without function group and hours will mislead the OR and can start a dispute the numbers do not support.
Joining verzuim or other health-related data to pay is unnecessary for this task and raises AVG special-category risk.
A US-style affirmative-action plan is the wrong programme for a Dutch employer. The work is equal treatment, CAO application and pay transparency.
If appraisal scores are a weak or biased input, tying them harder to pay makes the bias operable. The model must not invent a merit scheme the CAO does not allow.
research_questions: Does a periodiek in these CAOs move by time in grade, or can an appraisal score change a step?
Are gender, FTE percentage, function group and allowance components filled reliably enough in AFAS to compute a gap for equal work?
What has the OR already consented to on appraisal and variable pay?
What does the Dutch transposition of Directive (EU) 2023/970 actually require of a 1,200-employee employer as of this year?

tasks.short: Keep the handbook and the AFAS pay records in line.

today.trigger: A CAO update, a new allowance, a manager finding that the SharePoint PDF and AFAS disagree, or the yearly read-through of the handbook.
steps: Find the latest handbook PDF and whichever Word file was edited last.
Update the chapters on scales, allowances, pension and working hours.
Ask payroll whether AFAS can pay what the new sentence promises.
Mail the PDF and replace the copy on the main SharePoint site.
Correct individual AFAS scale or allowance fields when someone spots an error.
drudgery: Searching mail and team sites for a newer copy of the PDF
Line-by-line checking of scale tables against AFAS
Chasing managers who saved the old handbook locally
today.time_sinks: Version hunting and the manual check that the handbook, the CAO and AFAS say the same thing take most of the 43 hours.

lenses.faster: The clause diff and the list of AFAS records that do not match the scale table are prepared before the specialist reads anything. Retyping and the full manual cross-check drop out.
lenses.autonomous: A new CAO text or an AFAS scale import opens a change file: clauses touched, employees whose trede or allowance does not match, and draft handbook pages. Nothing is published and no employee record is written until approval.
lenses.ambitious: At a tenth of the cost, every manager would open one current text for that CAO and site, and the handbook could not drift from AFAS. Noordhaven would also keep agency workers out of the company handbook with a clear pointer to the agency's own terms.
lenses.joy: Hunting the right PDF is the work nobody will miss. What people still want is a reliable answer on the shift allowance in Tilburg or the starting trede for a reach-truck driver.
lenses.options: Where the CAO leaves a choice, the change file shows a few wordings of that clause, each with the CAO article beside it and a mark if that wording needs OR consent. The rest of the handbook is a single text.
lenses.altitude: The specialist maintains the map from CAO clause and wage component to handbook chapter, and works the exception queue. Page editing becomes the exception.
reach: HR Administrator: the correction queue for scale, trede and allowance fields on the employee record.
Payroll Specialist: the check that a component exists in AFAS before the handbook promises it.
Recruiter: a one-page current summary of scale and allowances to attach to an offer in Recruitee.

tasks.human_edge: Deciding whether a sentence is information or a change to employment conditions, and signing the version managers will rely on.
tasks.pattern_why: The work is several steps across the CAO text, AFAS and SharePoint, and the output is checkable against those sources. It changes what employees can rely on, so a person approves every published version and every record correction.

in_practice.trigger: A CAO text or scale table changes, or a scheduled comparison finds handbook lines that do not match AFAS wage components.
steps: Read the new CAO or policy text and list clauses that touch pay, allowances, pension or hours.
Compare that list with the current handbook and with AFAS scales and components.
Draft the changed handbook pages and a queue of employee records whose stored scale, trede or allowance does not match.
Specialist accepts, edits or rejects each page and each record correction. Payroll confirms any new component before the text promises it.
Publish only to the SharePoint library managers are told to use, and archive the previous PDF in the same place.
in_practice.human_gate: The specialist approves every handbook version before it is published. Where the change is a remuneration regulation, the OR consents first. AFAS employee fields change only on the specialist's or payroll's confirmation of the queued fix.
data_needed: Current handbook master and its published PDF location
CAO articles and wage tables that changed
AFAS wage-component catalogue, scales and tredes
Employee scale, trede and allowance values without BSN
Contract type, so agency workers are excluded from company conditions
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint handbook library with version, approver and date, plus a correction log of AFAS fields changed and why.

evidence.claim: SharePoint is a versioned document library and can be the single place the handbook is published.
AFAS Profit is Noordhaven's system of record for contracts, scales and wage components, so a mismatch with the handbook is a data comparison.
A language model can propose handbook edits from a source text and can also invent an allowance the CAO does not contain, so the publish step needs a person checking the source.

risks: A published sentence can become an employment condition by practice. A hallucinated allowance or pension promise creates claims.
Personnel records include BSN, salary and sometimes absence. The draft step must not copy individual dossiers into a tool outside the company tenant.
Agency workers are employed by the staffing firm. Writing them into the Noordhaven handbook as if the company CAO applied to them is legally wrong.
A handbook change that alters a remuneration or appraisal rule can require OR consent before publication.
research_questions: How often does the SharePoint handbook disagree with AFAS on a scale, trede or allowance, based on a sample of jobs at each site?
Which chapters are information, and which are regulations that need OR consent to change?
Can AFAS export scales and wage-component definitions without exporting BSN, absence or bank details?
Which SharePoint location do warehouse team leads actually open, and who else has copies?

tasks.short: Produce the org, career-path and pay reports people ask for.

today.trigger: A management or OR request, a job-evaluation exercise, or the compensation pack around the scale round.
steps: Export pay, FTE, org unit and job from AFAS or copy from Power BI into Excel.
Rebuild pivots for scales, allowances and headcount by site and CAO.
Update the org chart and a career-path sketch for the jobs in scope.
Paste the charts into PowerPoint or a Word memo.
Send the pack and correct the errors that come back.
drudgery: Rebuilding the same pivots for every request
Fixing org-chart boxes after a manager move
Reformatting charts so they fit the OR pack
today.time_sinks: Copying, pivoting and drawing the chart consume the 40 hours. The interpretation is a short meeting on top.

lenses.faster: The standard pack refreshes from the nightly AFAS extract: scales, allowances, FTE versus headcount, site and CAO. Manual pivots and hand-drawn org charts drop out for every job that is coded properly.
lenses.autonomous: The nightly refresh already runs. A failed refresh, a new job code, a missing manager link or a cell small enough to identify someone files an exception. The standard internal pack does not wait for a reminder.
lenses.ambitious: At a tenth of the cost, every HRBP would open a current pay-position and career-path view before a salary conversation, and the OR would see those same definitions. Noordhaven would finally have one org chart that matches AFAS, including vacancies and a separate flex layer.
lenses.joy: Formatting org charts and rebuilding pivots is the work nobody will miss. What remains is explaining a real spike, such as Venlo night shift or peak-season flex.
lenses.options: The same extract can be cut by CAO, by site and by job family, and can show a scenario of a general scale move next to a scenario that only changes a scarce allowance. The definitions stay fixed so the cuts still add up.
lenses.altitude: The specialist owns the report definitions and the exception rules, and checks that a measure was not quietly redefined. People Analytics keeps the pipeline running. The specialist stops assembling the pack.
reach: People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: the compensation pages and their measure definitions on the existing HR dashboard.
FP&A Analyst and Controller: a labour-cost bridge from gross pay and allowances that matches finance's personnel-cost line.
HR Business Partner: a team snapshot of grade and scale position before a pay conversation.

tasks.human_edge: Deciding what a surprising number means, and what must be hidden when a small shift team would make a colleague identifiable.
tasks.pattern_why: The inputs are structured AFAS fields and the output is a defined report with rules for small cells, missing managers and unknown job codes. A language model is not required to refresh the pack. Career-path text is added only where a job-family map exists.

in_practice.trigger: The nightly AFAS extract lands, a scale round opens, or a new job code appears.
steps: Refresh the compensation dataset in Power BI from the nightly extract.
Apply fixed definitions: own staff separate from flex, hours as FTE, allowances named as in AFAS.
Suppress cells below the agreed team size and list those suppressions.
Flag broken org links, new job codes and scales with no employees.
Specialist reviews the exception list and any pack that will go to the OR or the board, then releases that pack.
in_practice.human_gate: Routine internal refresh is available without a signature. The specialist reviews any pack going to the OR or the board, any suppressed cell someone asks to see, and any new job code before it enters a career-path view.
data_needed: Org unit, manager, job code, vacancy flag
CAO, function group, scale, trede, allowances, FTE
Employment relation: own contract versus agency worker
The agreed minimum cell size for pay figures
A job-family map where career-path lines are claimed
in_practice.logs_to: Power BI workspace history shared with People Analytics, and the SharePoint folder of packs actually sent to the OR or the board, with date and definition version.

evidence.claim: Noordhaven already refreshes Power BI from a nightly AFAS extract for HR and finance dashboards, which is the feed a standard compensation pack needs.
AFAS Profit holds organisation, position and employment data an org chart and a headcount report are built from.
Career-path reports need a maintained job-family map that a nightly payroll extract does not create by itself.

risks: Drawing agency workers as employees produces a false organisation for the OR and for finance.
A pay figure on a three-person night shift identifies individuals and is personal data under the AVG.
The extract is nightly. A report used for an offer the same afternoon can be a day behind AFAS.
A career-path picture that ignores the top of a CAO scale creates a promotion expectation the company cannot pay.
research_questions: Which of these reports are already a Power BI page, and which are still rebuilt in Excel?
Is the AFAS org structure complete for all three sites, including vacancies and acting team leads?
What minimum group size will the OR, privacy officer and HR Director accept before a pay cell is shown?
Do job-evaluation grades live in AFAS, or only in a spreadsheet held by this role?

tasks.short: Work out what a job requires and which jobs sit beside it.

today.trigger: A new warehouse or planning role, a dispute about which CAO function group applies, or a cluster of vacancies that recruiters cannot match to a job.
steps: Read the CAO function description and the vacancy texts in Recruitee.
Interview the supervisor and, for physical work, watch part of a shift.
Note the certificates Studytube already tracks, such as forklift, VCA and food safety.
Write how the job relates to the jobs next to it at the three sites.
File the note on SharePoint, often without a link to the AFAS job code.
drudgery: Collecting vacancy texts that describe the same job in different words
Retyping certificate and task lists that already exist
Searching old notes for a job Tilburg already studied
today.time_sinks: Desk research and write-up take as long as the floor visit, because previous work is hard to find and titles differ by site.

lenses.faster: CAO text, Recruitee vacancies and Studytube certificate names arrive as one brief with a draft requirement list. The specialist still spends the floor time with the supervisor. The blank-page write-up shrinks.
lenses.autonomous: A new AFAS job code, or a Recruitee vacancy that matches no existing profile, opens a desk brief and a list of similar titles at the other sites. It does not declare two jobs the same.
lenses.ambitious: At a tenth of the cost, Noordhaven would keep every warehouse, driver and office job current, including physical load and certificates, and would refresh the ones that change after peak season. Recruiters would hire against that profile, which is the first month of the path to a hire who is still productive at day 90.
lenses.joy: Collecting scattered PDFs and retyping task lists is the work nobody will miss. Supervisors still like a serious conversation about what the job is. The specialist still likes deciding the job structure.
lenses.options: The brief can offer more than one structure: one company-wide job, a site variant, or a CAO function group that almost fits with a documented gap. Each option shows the pay scale it would pull.
lenses.altitude: The specialist sets what a valid job profile must contain and reviews profiles that fail the check. The catalogue of relationships between jobs becomes the system. Individual note-writing becomes the exception.
reach: Recruiter: a requirement list and the matching AFAS job before a vacancy goes live in Recruitee.
Learning and Development Specialist: the certificates a job requires, aligned with Studytube courses.
HR Business Partner: a view of which titles across the three sites are one job, before a reorganisation.

tasks.human_edge: Watching the work and deciding that two titles are one job, or that the CAO function group does not describe what Noordhaven actually asks this person to do.
tasks.pattern_why: Desk sources can be assembled into a draft profile, but this task includes observation and interviews, and the conclusion changes grade and pay. The specialist leads the research and owns the decision that two jobs are the same job.

in_practice.trigger: A new job code, a vacancy whose text matches no profile, or a grade dispute that turns on what the job is.
steps: Pull the CAO function text, similar AFAS titles, open Recruitee vacancies and the Studytube certificates those vacancies name.
Draft a structured profile: tasks, certificates, physical load, adjacent jobs, and the CAO function group that seems to fit.
Specialist interviews the supervisor and watches the job where the work is physical or disputed.
Specialist accepts or rewrites the profile and records whether Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo are the same job.
Store the profile against the AFAS job code and tell recruitment and L&D what changed.
in_practice.human_gate: No profile is attached to a job code, and no function group is changed, until the specialist has confirmed it. A change of function group that moves pay follows the pay-method gate, including OR consent where the grading system itself changes.
data_needed: CAO function descriptions and function groups
AFAS job codes and titles by site
Recruitee vacancy texts and stated requirements
Studytube certificate types linked to courses
Supervisor name and site for the floor check
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint job catalogue linked to the AFAS job code, with date, sites covered, and whether a floor check was done.

evidence.claim: Recruitee already stores the vacancy texts and requirements Noordhaven recruiters use.
Studytube already stores enrolments and completions for mandatory certificates including forklift, VCA and food safety.
CBS and UWV publish occupational and regional labour-market figures a specialist can cite as inputs. They do not know Noordhaven's jobs.
Extracting tasks and certificates from a vacancy into a fixed template is plausible, and it is not reliable enough to set a CAO function group without a person and a floor check.

risks: A fluent summary that mis-states a CAO function group becomes a pay error for everyone in that job.
National labour-market figures mislead a three-site operator. The Rotterdam driver market is a different fact from Venlo.
Floor notes that describe a named worker's performance do not belong in a job profile. That mixes AVG personnel data into job evaluation.
Agency job descriptions are the staffing firm's jobs. Copying them in as Noordhaven function groups blurs who the employer is.
research_questions: Does the CAO function handbook already classify the driver and warehouse jobs Noordhaven uses, and where is Noordhaven's copy?
How many distinct AFAS job titles are the same work under different names across the three sites?
What share of these 40 hours is desk research, and what share is time on the floor?
Are CBS or UWV figures already used, and at what regional grain?

tasks.short: See which jobs need a proper analysis form, and make the form.

today.trigger: A role that has drifted, a new activity such as a more automated warehouse line, or a grade dispute with no recent questionnaire.
steps: Judge from memory and manager complaints which jobs are out of date.
Copy last year's Word questionnaire and edit the questions.
Ask an HRBP to send it to supervisors.
Collect replies by mail and summarize them in Excel.
Store the form wherever the previous one was stored.
drudgery: Rebuilding the same questionnaire from an old file
Chasing supervisors for replies during a shift week
Rekeying mailed answers into a sheet
today.time_sinks: Drafting and chasing replies take longer than deciding whether the job needed a new instrument.

lenses.faster: A first draft of the task inventory, physical-demand checklist and interview guide is prepared from the last accepted profile and the CAO factors. The specialist edits factors. Supervisors are not asked to endure a long form unless the job is actually new or disputed.
lenses.autonomous: A job code with no completed instrument, or a Recruitee vacancy that fits no profile, opens a draft pack and a recommendation to use the short form or the full form. Nothing is sent to supervisors until the specialist releases it.
lenses.ambitious: At a tenth of the cost, every warehouse and driver job would have a current instrument, including lifting, cold store, night work and certificates, refreshed when the work changes. Grade disputes would start from that form. Hiring would start from the same form.
lenses.joy: Rebuilding last year's Word file is the work nobody will miss. A short, fair form is something supervisors will still tolerate. The specialist keeps the part worth doing: a factor structure that matches the work.
lenses.options: Each job can have a 15-minute supervisor checklist or a full evaluation used when the grade is disputed, and a warehouse version beside a transport version. The specialist picks one to send.
lenses.altitude: The specialist maintains the factor library and the rule for when a job needs a new instrument, then reviews completed forms that fail checks. Question design becomes a maintained system.
reach: Recruiter: the intake questions for a new vacancy, taken from the same factor library.
Learning and Development Specialist: physical and certificate requirements translated into Studytube courses.
HR Business Partner: a standard question set for a reorganisation that creates or merges jobs.

tasks.human_edge: Choosing the factors that matter on a warehouse floor and in a driver's cab, and judging whether the form is honest enough to base a grade on.
tasks.pattern_why: The specialist must decide which job needs an instrument and which factors the CAO and the supervisors will recognise. AI can draft the form and the short and long variants. A weak form sent to shift supervisors contaminates every grade built from it, so the person remains the author of what goes out.

in_practice.trigger: A job profile is older than the agreed age, a new job code has no instrument, or a grade is disputed.
steps: List jobs missing a current instrument, using AFAS job codes and the catalogue from the job-profile work.
Draft the short checklist and, where needed, the full form from the factor library and the CAO function factors.
Specialist cuts the draft to what a supervisor can answer about the job, and removes any question about a named person.
HRBP or the specialist sends the released form and books time that fits the shift.
Answers land in a structured sheet. The specialist reviews forms that fail checks before they can update a profile or a grade.
in_practice.human_gate: No form is sent until the specialist releases that version. No answer updates a grade or a function group until the specialist accepts it.
data_needed: Job code, site, CAO and last instrument date
Approved factor library and CAO function factors
Supervisor and shift pattern for who is asked
Certificate list from Studytube for that job family
A rule that responses describe the job, stored without employee names
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint instrument library: version sent, date, jobs covered, response count, and which responses were accepted into a profile.

evidence.claim: Microsoft Forms, included with Microsoft 365, can collect a fixed questionnaire into a spreadsheet.
Drafting a task inventory from an existing job profile and a factor list is a plausible language-model step when a person releases the form.
Studytube's course and certificate catalogue is a structured source for the certificate section of a job instrument.

risks: Questions that ask supervisors to score people rather than jobs contaminate job evaluation and collect personnel data the form does not need.
Physical-demand answers stored on a named employee start to look like health data. Store them on the job.
A form that ignores the CAO's own function factors will not support a grade the OR recognises.
Sending a long form into a peak shift without the site manager's backing produces junk answers and annoyed supervisors.
research_questions: Is there an existing evaluation method, CAO function groups or a company system, and where do the current forms live?
How many active job codes have no profile or instrument updated in the last two years?
Will a warehouse supervisor complete a form during a shift, or does an HRBP need to interview them?
Can Studytube certificate types be linked to a job, or only to a person?

tasks.short: Answer pay and workforce questions from finance, managers and the OR.

today.trigger: Finance preparing a forecast, the OR asking for a pay picture, a reorganisation, or an external statistical request that needs occupation or pay classifications.
steps: Pull a fresh Excel from AFAS or Power BI when the question arrives.
Reconcile pay components with payroll and, for flex, with agency invoices and accounts payable.
Write a short answer with a chart attached.
Explain the figure in the meeting.
Redo the cut when someone challenges the definition.
drudgery: Rebuilding a workbook for a question that was asked last quarter
Reconciling three site files and the flex invoices
Rewriting caveats that the audience did not read
today.time_sinks: Definition repairs and flex-versus-own-staff reconciliation take longer than the analysis the meeting actually needs.

lenses.faster: The specialist starts from a checked dataset of pay, grade, site, CAO, allowance and FTE, and edits a first written answer. Building the workbook from exports drops out for questions that match a stored definition.
lenses.autonomous: Recurring packs, such as the quarterly labour-cost bridge and the OR pay report, refresh when the nightly extract lands and wait for the specialist's note. A one-off question from the Finance Director does not run out unattended.
lenses.ambitious: At a tenth of the cost, every reorganisation and every CAO scenario would arrive with the occupation mix and the cost before the decision, and the OR would see the same numbers as finance. The split between own staff and flex, by site and job family, would be a standing fact.
lenses.joy: VLOOKUP repairs across site files are the work nobody will miss. Standing behind a number in front of the OR, and saying what the data cannot prove, is the part worth keeping.
lenses.options: A CAO wage rise, a different night-shift pattern, and bringing a block of flex hours in-house can sit as scenarios on the same definitions. The audience sees more than one plan without three different workbooks.
lenses.altitude: The specialist sets the measures: what counts as a compensation euro, how flex is shown, which cells are too small. People Analytics runs the pipeline. The specialist audits the narrative against those measures.
reach: FP&A Analyst: labour-cost scenarios for a CAO rise or a shift-pattern change.
Controller: a personnel-cost definition that matches the general ledger on the AFAS finance side.
HR Business Partner: the numbers for a team-change business case.
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: shared ownership of the compensation dataset.

tasks.human_edge: Putting a name to a number in front of finance and the OR, including the sentence about what this cut cannot prove.
tasks.pattern_why: The dataset can be prepared by rules from AFAS. The product this task asks for is a technical answer a board, an OR or a filing can rely on. That answer stays with the specialist, because a wrong join repeated to the OR is expensive to unwind.

in_practice.trigger: A recurring OR or finance date, or a written question from the HR Director, Finance Director, Controller or an HRBP.
steps: Map the question onto a stored definition, or write a new definition before running anything.
Refresh the cut from the AFAS extract. Add flex cost only from the source finance already uses for agency invoices.
Draft a short answer: the figure, the definition, the exclusions, and two scenarios where the question is a decision.
Specialist checks the total against payroll or the ledger and removes any cell that identifies a person.
The specialist or the HR Director sends the answer. The note is filed with the papers for that meeting.
in_practice.human_gate: No figure goes to the OR, the board, a union or a government form until the specialist has checked the definition and the total. Finance remains accountable for any number it files from the ledger.
data_needed: AFAS pay, FTE, org unit, CAO, function group, allowances
General-ledger personnel-cost account for the reconciliation
Agency cost from accounts payable or the agency portals, kept separate from gross pay
Cell-size rule for AVG
The exact question and the audience
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint folder of management and OR briefings, each note citing the Power BI report and the definition version it used.

evidence.claim: Power BI already publishes HR and finance dashboards on a nightly AFAS extract at this company.
AFAS Profit posts payroll into the general ledger, so a personnel-cost bridge between HR and finance has a system of record on both sides.
Drafting a narrative from a fixed table is editable copilot work. It does not replace a person when the number is going to the OR or into a filing.

risks: A fluent note with a wrong join, such as counting flex invoices inside gross pay, will be repeated to the OR and to finance.
Small departments at Venlo or a single night shift make many interesting cuts personal data.
Industry benchmark figures that are not Dutch logistics will set the wrong expectation in a CAO environment where scales are largely given.
Statistical returns and pension-fund occupation codes have legal definitions. A paraphrase is not a filing. Payroll and finance stay responsible for what is submitted.
research_questions: Which questions from the OR, the board and finance recur each quarter, and which were one-off last year?
Is flex agency cost in the AFAS HR extract, or only in the agency portals and accounts payable?
Who is allowed to release a people-cost number to the OR today, and how often does Excel disagree with Power BI?
Which external returns does this role actually feed, versus payroll, finance or the pension administrator?

tasks.short: Prepare and give the training on how our pay rules work.

today.trigger: New team leads, a CAO change, or HRBPs asking for a session because managers are promising the wrong trede.
steps: Build a PowerPoint from the handbook and a few recent questions.
Invent worked examples of steps, shift allowances and a promotion.
Deliver the session in Teams or on a site, sometimes with L&D.
Answer the follow-up mail from team leads.
Ask L&D to record completion in Studytube if a course shell exists.
drudgery: Formatting slides from a handbook that has already changed
Inventing examples that do not match the real scales
Repeating the same answers by mail after the session
today.time_sinks: Slide building and post-session mail take as long as the session, across about 33 hours a year.

lenses.faster: Worked examples are drafted from the approved handbook: a reach-truck driver moving a trede in Tilburg, a planner placed on the wrong CAO, a promotion that has to stay inside the scale. The live session stays on the calendar.
lenses.autonomous: When the handbook or a CAO scale changes, a draft update to the manager module opens, with the list of team leads whose Studytube completion is on the old version. Enrolment and the session do not happen without the specialist and L&D.
lenses.ambitious: At a tenth of the cost, every new team lead would practise pay conversations before their first salary talk, with cases from all three sites, refreshed the week a CAO change lands. Fewer wrong promises means fewer offer and probation failures, which is the north star of a hire still productive at day 90.
lenses.joy: Formatting slides and inventing numbers that are not in the CAO is the work nobody will miss. A short session with real rules and straight answers is the part team leads value.
lenses.options: The same case library can offer a standard trede, a split-CAO case and a disputed grade, in a version for warehouse team leads and a shorter version for HRBPs. The specialist picks the set for that room.
lenses.altitude: The specialist maintains the case library and the rule for when a policy change forces a module update. L&D owns Studytube administration and session design. The specialist teaches the exceptions and the newly changed rules.
reach: Learning and Development Specialist: the pay-policy content inside the existing manager curriculum on Studytube.
HR Business Partner: a practised way to handle a difficult pay case before they coach the manager.
Recruiter: a short, current explanation of scale and allowances for offer conversations.

tasks.human_edge: Reading the room when a team lead challenges a scale, and keeping every example fictional so nobody's pay is discussed in the group.
tasks.pattern_why: L&D already runs the learning system. This role supplies the pay content and the live explanation. Drafts and cases shorten preparation. Conducting the session is presence and trust, and a model must not score managers on pay decisions.

in_practice.trigger: The handbook or a CAO scale is approved in a new version, or a cohort of new team leads starts.
steps: Draft updated cases and speaker notes strictly from the approved handbook and the current scales.
Specialist rewrites anything that the CAO does not say, and replaces any example that could be a real employee.
L&D places the materials in the existing Studytube module and invites the named cohort.
The specialist runs the live session for exceptions and new rules. L&D runs administration and completion tracking.
Questions that would change someone's pay leave the room and go to the HRBP and this role as a case, not as a classroom decision.
in_practice.human_gate: No module is published in Studytube until the specialist has checked the cases against the approved handbook. The specialist, not a model, answers anything that would determine a person's pay.
data_needed: Approved handbook version and current scale tables
List of team-lead roles from AFAS, without salary rows
Prior Studytube completion on the manager pay module
A case library of fictional examples tagged to the handbook version
in_practice.logs_to: Studytube course version and completion record, and the SharePoint case library with the handbook version each case was checked against.

evidence.claim: Studytube already administers courses, enrolments and completions at Noordhaven, including mandatory certificates, so a manager module has a system to live in.
PowerPoint and Teams are already the company's tools for a short internal session.
Drafting practice cases from an approved policy is reliable enough to edit and not reliable enough to publish unedited.

risks: A slide that contradicts the handbook or the CAO becomes something a team lead will rely on. Materials have to be checked against the signed version.
Using a real salary row in class exposes personal data under the AVG and damages trust on the floor.
Recording role-play that includes real employee situations, or letting a model score managers in a way that affects their employment, moves this into high-risk employment AI and is out of scope.
A second course stack owned by compensation, beside L&D's Studytube curriculum, will split completion records. One module, one owner for administration.
research_questions: Of these 33 hours, how many are building materials and how many are delivering sessions?
Is there already a manager module on terms and conditions in Studytube, and does L&D or compensation own it?
Do team leads currently learn CAO application from a maintained document or from payroll and each other?
Can Studytube report completions for a cohort without exporting learner personal data to a general-purpose model?

role.altitude: Owner of Noordhaven's pay rules. The specialist designs the functiehuis, the mapping onto both CAOs, the exception policy, and the checks that keep AFAS, the handbook, the offer and the OR pack on the same facts, and steps in for disputes, new jobs and CAO changes.
reach: People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: compensation measure definitions, small-cell rules and data-quality checks on the nightly AFAS extract.
Payroll Specialist: a pre-payroll test that a new scale, trede or allowance is configured in AFAS before the first live run.
FP&A Analyst: labour-cost scenarios for a CAO rise, a shift pattern or a change in flex volume.
Controller: one definition of personnel cost that compensation reports and the general ledger both use.
HR Business Partner: the allowed step, the precedent and the options before a promotion or regrading conversation.
Recruiter: the scale, trede and allowances for an offer, taken from the current rule and recorded in Recruitee.
Learning and Development Specialist: the content of the manager module on terms and conditions, inside Studytube.
HR Administrator: the correction queue for scale, trede and allowance fields.
role.ceiling_note: The limit is one FTE on a calendar other people control. These eight tasks are about 335 hours, roughly a fifth of the year. The rest is individual pay questions, the scale round and CAO implementation, on the same systems. OR consent, payroll cut-off and the week new scales go live set the pace. Job analysis and training need hours on site in Rotterdam, Tilburg or Venlo, and this person can be on one site at a time. Small shift teams make many pay cuts personal data. A named person stays accountable for an individual's pay, because of equal treatment, the works council and the employment category of the EU AI Act.
skills_to_grow: Writing pay rules as tests that payroll or a script can run against AFAS wage components
An equal-pay and pay-transparency method that a 1,200-person Dutch employer can explain to the OR, matched to the actual transposition of Directive (EU) 2023/970
A functiehuis that covers both CAOs and three sites without inventing grades the CAO forbids
Specifying an AFAS component change so payroll can configure it and prove it on a test employee
Defining measures with People Analytics, including flex treated separately and small cells suppressed
Recognising which changes are works-council consent items under the WOR, and which are information only
role.ambitious_version: Noordhaven runs one functiehuis for both CAOs. Every job has a current profile, a grade, a scale and the certificates Studytube expects. A manager sees the allowed step before promising it. Finance and the OR see the same labour-cost picture, with flex shown separately. The specialist spends the year on CAO changes, new warehouse work, disputes, and on whether pay policy shows up in 90-day retention, absence and offer acceptance.
